spec.expr: label_replace(((min(tyk_mdcb_license_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id"}) - time()) / 86400) < 0, "state", "✕ Expired", "", "") or label_replace(((min(tyk_mdcb_license_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id"}) - time()) / 86400) >= 0 < 14, "state", "✕ Under 14 days", "", "") or label_replace(((min(tyk_mdcb_license_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id"}) - time()) / 86400) >= 14 < 30, "state", "⚠ Under 30 days", "", "") or label_replace(((min(tyk_mdcb_license_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id"}) - time()) / 86400) >= 30, "state", "✓ Over 30 days", "", "")

spec.title: License expiry date
spec.description: Date this control plane's MDCB license expires. Metric: tyk.mdcb.license.expiry_timestamp

spec.expr: min(tyk_mdcb_license_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id"}) * 1000

options.content: [Open ${deployment_environment} in the Tyk Developer Portal dashboard ↗](/d/tyk-portal/tyk-portal?var-deployment_environment=${deployment_environment}&${__url_time_range}&${datasource:queryparam})

spec.title: Portal instances
spec.description: Developer Portal instances reporting in this environment. Metric: process.uptime

spec.expr: count(count by (service_instance_id) (process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"}))

spec.title: Last successful provider sync
spec.description: How long ago the provider that synced longest ago last synced with Tyk Dashboard. Thresholds assume the default 10 minute refresh interval. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.sync.last_success_timestamp

spec.expr: label_replace((max(time() - max by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"} > 0))) < 1200, "state", "✓ Under 20 min ago", "", "") or label_replace((max(time() - max by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"} > 0))) >= 1200 < 1800, "state", "⚠ 20 to 30 min ago", "", "") or label_replace((max(time() - max by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"} > 0))) >= 1800, "state", "✕ Over 30 min ago", "", "")

spec.title: Unreachable providers
spec.description: Providers whose Tyk Dashboard the portal could not reach or authenticate to on the last sync. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.reachable

spec.expr: label_replace((count(min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"}) == 0) or on() (0 * count(min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"})))) == 0, "state", "✓ All reachable", "", "") or label_replace((count(min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"}) == 0) or on() (0 * count(min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"})))) > 0, "state", "✕ Not reachable", "", "")

spec.title: Failed provider syncs (last 30 min)
spec.description: Provider syncs that failed in the last 30 minutes, all providers and causes. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.sync.failures

spec.expr: label_replace((sum(increase(tyk_portal_provider_sync_failures_total{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"}[30m])) or on() (0 * count(tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"}))) < 0.5, "state", "✓ No failures", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(tyk_portal_provider_sync_failures_total{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"}[30m])) or on() (0 * count(tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment"}))) >= 0.5, "state", "⚠ Syncs failed", "", "")

spec.title: Database
spec.description: The portal database. Shows whether its latest ping passed within 5 seconds, worst result across instances. Metric: tyk.portal.health

spec.expr: min(tyk_portal_health{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",component="database"})

spec.title: File storage
spec.description: Where the portal keeps themes and uploaded files. Shows whether its latest read check passed within 5 seconds, worst result across instances. Metric: tyk.portal.health

spec.expr: min(tyk_portal_health{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",component="storage"})
